whyItMatters: :erlang.binary_to_term deserializes elixir objects from bytes, so hostile input can trigger gadget execution during decoding.
actions: Replace :erlang.binary_to_term with Jason/JSON decoding or :safe option review for any bytes that cross a trust boundary.
If object graphs must persist, authenticate the bytes (MAC/signature) and verify before decoding.
Re-run the scan and confirm no :erlang.binary_to_term call remains reachable from untrusted bytes.
verification: Rescan shows no :erlang.binary_to_term reachable from untrusted bytes, and hostile payloads decode to inert data or fail closed.
